text: Who are the leading Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Melbourne for building custom operational business apps for warehouse, shop-floor, or field teams?

result.keyword: Who are the leading Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Melbourne for building custom operational business apps for warehouse, shop-floor, or field teams?

items.markdown:
When building custom operational business apps (such as inventory trackers, shop-floor data capture, barcode scanning, or field-service tools) on **[Microsoft Power Apps](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/microsoft-365/business/microsoft-powerapps)** and **Dataverse** in Melbourne, you want specialists who understand robust offline capabilities, hardware integrations (like barcode scanners/cameras), and complex relational data modeling.

The leading consultants and specialized Microsoft partners servicing Melbourne for heavy operational and frontline use cases include:

1. **Inturing** 
	- **Specialty:** Highly focused on industrial operations, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, and wholesale execution. They explicitly design shop-floor Power Apps, inventory/replenishment workflows, and field operations apps integrated with Dataverse and analytics.
	- **Best for:** End-to-end operational execution connecting back-office systems to frontline or warehouse workers. Learn more or connect via [Inturing Manufacturing & Operations](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing).[[1]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)[[2]](https://www.inturing.com.au/retail-wholesale)
2. **Office Experts Group / Power Platform Experts** 
	- **Specialty:** An established Australian Microsoft consulting firm with a dedicated local Melbourne presence. They specialize in custom low-code application development using Power Apps, complex automated business processes via Power Automate, and seamless Dataverse integration.
	- **Best for:** Core process optimization, structured data architecture, and custom internal business applications. Explore their services at [Power Platform Consultants Melbourne](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-melbourne).[[1]](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-melbourne)
3. **Engage Squared** 
	- **Specialty:** A prominent, multi-award-winning Melbourne-headquartered Microsoft partner. While renowned for modern workplace and enterprise collaboration, their Power Platform practice scales enterprise-grade custom applications, governance frameworks, and secure Dataverse implementations for larger operational environments.
	- **Best for:** Mid-to-large enterprises needing robust security, change management, and scaled platform governance. Visit [Engage Squared](https://engagesq.com/) to review their enterprise capabilities.[[1]](https://revenuebase.ai/companies/microsoft-power-platform-consultants/australia/melbourne)
4. **KLX Consulting** 
	- **Specialty:** A Melbourne-based boutique Microsoft specialist consultancy focused purely on extracting measurable operational value from Dynamics 365, Azure, and the Power Platform stack.
	- **Best for:** Tailored, lean architectures where custom Power Apps need to tie closely into broader Microsoft ecosystem tools or ERP systems. Check out [KLX Consulting](https://www.klxconsulting.com.au/).[[1]](https://revenuebase.ai/companies/microsoft-power-platform-consultants/australia/melbourne)

- Do these apps require **offline mode** for remote field teams or poor-signal warehouses?
- Will they need integration with specific systems like **ERP/Inventory management software (e.g., SAP, Dynamics, Unleashed)**?
